lines.text: Every leaf on the old oak had fallen. All but one.
lines.sub:
Every leaf on the old oak had fallen.
All but one.

lines.text: Every morning, on her way to school, she checked on it.
lines.sub:
Every morning, on her way to school,
she checked on it.

lines.text: The wind tried. The rain tried.
lines.sub: The wind tried. The rain tried.

lines.text: Then, one still, cold morning, it let go.
lines.sub:
Then, one still, cold morning,
it let go.

lines.text: She pressed it in her favourite book.
lines.sub: She pressed it in her favourite book.
